devil_advocate: 500GB transferred to an external IP overnight is the textbook definition of data exfiltration. Without the change management cross-reference, this case should trigger an alert. With the change record, it resolves to NOISE. A sophisticated attacker could have modified the authorized backup destination IP. However: the change ticket predates the transfer by 5 days and has CISO authority — forging this would require CISO-level access, which would make the exfiltration itself trivial.
